author: bardic-inspiration
name: Thornveil Stag
summary: An ancient stag in a crown of antlers so overgrown with briar that it looks like a walking hedge.
description: The woods keep a stag like this the way a house keeps a hearth: out of sight, doing something important. Hunters who have loosed an arrow at one tend to find the briars waiting for them on the walk home.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the stag moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:2d6:piercing} and, if it is Huge or smaller, has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

traits.name: Briar Crown
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn grappling the stag, or that touches it, takes {dmg:1d6:piercing}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stag makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

actions.name: Entangling Thorns

save.targets: each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the stag can see within 60 feet

actions.onFailure: , and the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the end of the stag's next turn as briars coil around it.
